F.U.C.           E.3.(s) (Mr. Sykes)

I regret the delay in replying to your note of 10.11.41, but I have only just been able to obtain the files.

In reply to your enquiry, it is, I think, better that your source should not endeavour to make contact with the LOWE MEMBERS.

23.11.41.

N. Pilkington.
